title: Chest Item : Useful Book
description: adds a useful feature to the collection manual in "Chest curio item"
body:
This mod adds a useful feature to the collection manual in "Chest curio item". When you collect some special items, you will receive permanent rewards, which may be "health points", "resistance", or even "Fortrue"

![book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca22016af8571a8c32e9fd26a5f6aa47feb60356.png)
 
You can see the bonuses for these items in the description in the collection manual
﻿
﻿
Of course, this mod is in its early stages and more effects will be added in the future. You can check the progress of this mod on Github
